name: 夕阳再现
english_name: Sunset Reappears: Storm Rises Again II
english_description: The "Storm Rises Again II" branch of the true Sunset Reappears lineage: unlike its similarly-"Sunset Reappears"-branded siblings xysylmhb and xyzxiiylzymh (whose maps actually belong to the unrelated "Tianya" family), this archive's world data really is byte-identical to jhfy3, xajh4gkb, and xyzxyl201412 -- four snapshots of the same authored map running on different security-layer implementations. New characters start not at the genre's usual South City Inn but at Northern Frontier Town, an unusually rare Central-Asian-flavored setting for this corpus, with an adjoining Bai's Family Courtyard (named for a term for a wealthy landowner in Xinjiang) evoking a frontier backdrop rather than the standard Jiangnan wuxia one. Its login/registration flow closely mirrors xysylmhb's (the same dual admin-password/login-password scheme), but unlike xysylmhb, this build's standard port skips the old Tomud client handshake entirely -- the literal "2060" version check only fires on a separate, dedicated Tomud-only port.
